name: Package-maintainer continuity and provenance monitoring

attribution.legal_posture: Source-attributed public security research; legal adjudication, civil-identity finding, and same-operator scope remain unresolved.

caveats: A familiar maintainer name offers a continuity lead after an account takeover; continuity requires source-backed account evidence.
Treat a compromised maintainer as a victim; coordinate privately and avoid publishing credentials, exploit details, or infrastructure selectors.

statements: Defenders and package ecosystems should correlate abrupt maintainer or publisher changes, newly linked repository organizations, package-version timing, provenance/signing changes, and unexpected infrastructure transitions. A familiar maintainer name is not sufficient after an account takeover.

sources.support: Defenders and package ecosystems should correlate abrupt maintainer or publisher changes, newly linked repository organizations, package-version timing, provenance/signing changes, and unexpected infrastructure transitions. sources.locator: Sections “Account Takeover” and “Safety Measures,” especially the repository redirects, release timing, privileged-account activity, and contributor/package-monitoring guidance
